shots.focal_element: Index finger pressing a backlit elevator call button (up arrow) on a dark panel
shots.what_happens: Very short (about 0.34 s) letterboxed live-action insert: a finger enters from the left and presses the glowing up-arrow call button. No speech. It is part of a rapid montage of the character heading to the office. Only a keyframe was provided for this shot, with no contact sheet.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut in a sub-half-second 2.39:1 letterboxed macro clip of a finger pressing a lit button, timed to land on the montage's music pulse.

shots.focal_element: Woman with long wavy hair seen from behind, framed in the open elevator doorway
shots.what_happens: Symmetrical back view of the character stepping into a wood-panelled elevator, held for about 0.42 s. Vignetted edges and letterbox bars. No speech.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 0.4 s symmetrical over-the-back shot of the subject entering a doorway, centred in a letterboxed frame with a soft edge vignette.

shots.focal_element: Finger pressing the floor button labelled 12, which is ringed with a red light
shots.typography: Diegetic floor numbers on the elevator buttons: rounded sans-serif numerals, light on dark keycaps. They are part of the set, not a graphic overlay.
shots.what_happens: Shallow-focus macro of a finger pressing floor 12 (the button lights red) for about 0.38 s. The anchors list a whoosh SFX candidate (x084) inside this shot. No speech.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut a 0.38 s shallow-depth-of-field macro of a button press on the right third, with the finger blurred in the foreground and a whoosh accent on the cut.

shots.focal_element: Hand gripping and pushing down a brushed-steel door lever
shots.what_happens: The contact sheet (1:18.5) shows a close-up of a hand opening a door by its lever. The mid-shot keyframe instead shows the woman framed between closing elevator doors. The two images disagree, so what this 0.46 s shot contains and in what order is unclear. No speech.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut a sub-half-second close-up of a hand pressing a door lever, using it as one beat in a fast commute montage before the office reveal.

shots.focal_element: The woman in a burgundy blazer moving through an open-plan office toward her seated colleague
shots.what_happens: Lateral tracking shot across a busy open-plan office. Foreground monitors (showing an unreadable spreadsheet-style table), a desk lamp and desk clutter slide past as she arrives beside the seated man on the right. The montage ends here, and she starts speaking at the very end of the shot (w206 'Jim,').
shots.build_rebuild: Shoot a 2 s lateral truck past foreground desk props, or fake one with layered parallax, so the props slide faster than the subject; end on her arrival as the first line of dialogue starts.

shots.focal_element: Two-shot of the woman (left) and her colleague Jim (right) seated side by side
shots.what_happens: Static medium two-shot by a bright window, played as comedy. The dialogue runs w207-w217 ('you won't believe this. You decided on Fuchsia for your kitchen.'). Across the frames she shuts her eyes, then gives him a sideways look, while he turns toward her talking. The line pattern suggests she opens with news and he wrongly guesses a kitchen colour, but who says which line cannot be confirmed from stills.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a locked-off medium two-shot with a soft background for about 2.5 s, playing the dialogue across both subjects so the left subject's reaction carries the joke.
